notes: Device inventory is an example, confirm the enabled supply list.
SAD:* PVs in legacy_inventory.json configure the old SAD server, not direct device channels.
DR:monitors decoding comes from existing InterfaceATF2_DR.get_bpms: numbered slots 1..98 except 20,75; raw positions /1000 -> mm. Confirm operational COD mapping and provide longitudinal positions.
TBT channel names come from op-base Turn1024. Their BPM mapping is separate from the COD slot list and must be supplied.
DeltaFRamp mode writes RAMP:* switches as in SysID. The controller owns linked LN/DR/water actions; no direct FREQUENCY write is made. Presets are kHz, frequency readback display is MHz.
Source confirms :parameter.A is LOWER and :parameter.B is UPPER; read per supply before probes and writes. Corrector limits are intersected with +/-5 A.
TBT source labels raw positions in um; normalize to mm with factor 0.001. Historical beta calibration is recorded, not auto-applied to arbitrary excitation.
BPM mapping remains unconfirmed: live interface has MB97R/98R and omits MB20R/75R, but local TBT positions and Twiss table describe MB1R..96R. See forms/bpm_mapping_audit.json.
RF tolerance/settle_s remain unset because local SysID checks switch readback but provides no established beam/RF settling interval.
User confirms DR:monitors has slots through 98. Readout extent does not establish the TBT-96 physical mapping.
Q modulation uses the trim member of mag_ki_main with measured main-coil current. Fill actual supply PVs and :parameter.A/B before enabling each magnet.
TBT completion generation must certify ALL buffers from the new shot; TBT:TUNE:H is not assumed to provide that guarantee.
No live hardware writes occur during construction. Unconfirmed tune-scan prerequisites are rejected before moving a quadrupole.
User confirmed no dedicated completion PV. Default readback_checks uses TBT:TUNE:H timestamps and all waveform timestamps/content stability; it cannot prove a common shot ID.

User permits existing mag_ki_main calibration provisionally; library path and device mapping still must be configured. Optional field_check supports site blWrite/blWriteCalc readbacks with EXPLICIT unit conversion and matching coil convention.

Quad supply PV names follow MagnetLibrary currentWrite/currentRead and dot-to-underscore convention as CANDIDATES; enable only confirmed devices with mapping_confirmed. library=null builds the existing workspace libmagnet C sources in /tmp.

Q modulation defaults to existing TuneDR H/V PVs (monitor/TBT/TuneDR/fft.cpp). Require BOTH timestamps to advance after each request; .5 s maximum H/V skew is provisional. Set mode=tbt to use newly acquired BPM waveform fits instead.
